_comment: Guided tour of the Structure Tools workspace (the hub). Each tool inside has its own Guide; this one shows how to move between them. The awaited step waits for the user to pick a tool.

steps.title: One window, several structure tools
steps.text: Structure Tools gathers the tools that prepare and check structures for FRET: the FPS JSON editor, docking, the quenching estimator, hydrodynamics and trajectory tools. Each keeps its own state while you work in another. You press the controls; the tour only points at them.

steps.title: Find a tool
steps.text: Type part of a name or description and the list shows only the tools that match. Leave it empty to see all of them.

steps.title: Open the quenching estimator
steps.text: Each row opens one tool. QuEst simulates dye diffusion next to quenching residues and predicts the decay; pick it and the right-hand area becomes that tool. The tools are loaded the first time you select them.

steps.title: The tool itself
steps.text: Everything in this area belongs to the selected tool and has its own Guide and Help buttons. Switching away and back keeps its settings and results.

steps.title: Walk the list
steps.text: Back and Next step to the neighbouring tool without reaching for the list.
